events.title: Hibernate ORM released
events.summary: Gavin King released Hibernate on May 23, 2001 — an open-source [Java] ORM that mapped objects to relational tables without EJB entity beans.
events.about: Hibernate (`Session.save(user)`) became the default way [Java] apps talk to Postgres and MySQL — annotations, HQL queries, and lazy loading without hand-written JDBC. It influenced JPA and Spring Data; most enterprise [Java] stacks still run Hibernate or its spec under the hood.

narrative.whyChosen: Hibernate proved lightweight ORM could replace heavyweight [Java] EE persistence.
narrative.whyImportant: Its patterns became the basis for JPA and shaped how [Java] backends model databases.
narrative.problemSolved: EJB2 entity beans were verbose, [container]-dependent, and painful for typical web applications.
